content:
On May 26, the Webinar “Olhar os Desafios da Engenharia XXI” is held, an initiative of the Dinheiro Vivo portal in partnership with the Order of Engineers, which will be attended by Rita Moura, from PTPC/Cluster AEC and chairman of the Board of Directors of BUILT CoLAB.

The online event will also be attended by Carlos Mineiro Aires, Bastonário of the Order of Engineers, Miguel Castro Neto, deputy director of Nova IMS, Francisco Ferreira, of Associação Zero. All stakeholders are engineers and will share their views on the subject, debating the future of the profession.

According to the news shared by Dinheiro Vivo, the Bastonário of the Order of Engineers will make his speech on the importance of engineering in achieving the main public policies and national investment vectors, Miguel Castro Neves will talk about the digitization of processes and the new cities (the so-called smart cities). The intervention of Francisco Ferreira will be on mitigating the impact of climate change, and Rita Moura will share a view of the area of construction and infrastructure.

The session will be issued on May 26, at 10 a.m.
